We see the profound impact that our graphene solutions will have in transforming the industry. We invite you to join us in driving change with our fundamentally human-centered approach, uniting bright minds around a shared vision. Our graphene photonic innovation increases computing power and efficiency to a new order of magnitude. In short, we connect chips to create powerful and energy-efficient networks, overcoming connectivity limitations in the semiconductor industry. We deliver the graphene solution. jobs.description: Freelance Assignment 4 January to 30 April 2027 5 days a week, with 3 days in the office (Mondays, Wednesdays & Thursdays) Reporting to COO The Challenge Every day, people in 180+ countries top up Talk360 to call someone who matters. We're looking for an interim who does two jobs at once: keep operations running and go deep on payments to create order, so that when Ewan is back he has an operating model and a plan he can run with. Strategic enough to see the whole picture. Hands-on enough to fix what's broken before lunch. jobs.description: About us Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. We’re based in Utrecht (NL) with a second office in Toronto (CA), and our 120+ team members work in a culture that’s open, flat, and inclusive, where curiosity drives us, ownership matters, and everyone has the freedom to challenge ideas and make an impact. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next! Mission of this role Thousands of customers, most of our customer base, work with Rentman without a dedicated Customer Success Manager. They sign up, set up Rentman and get to work, but not all of them get the most out of what they pay for, and today we mostly help them when they reach out to us. We want to change that. Your job is to make sure every one of them gets the most out of what they pay for, starting with new customers in their first months. Instead of adding CSMs at the same rate as we grow, we’re building a system of signals, plays and AI agents that helps these customers adopt Rentman, stay and grow with us. However, a human touch always stays: our pooled CSMs step in at the moments where a person makes the difference. This is a new role and a new function, and you start as a team of one. You’ll build Digital CS from the start, with support from Data, Ops and AI engineering and a direct report to our Head of CX. There’s room to shape how AI agents are used in Customer Success, and a growth path towards CS or Revenue Operations. What you'll do Explore product usage, engagement, billing and support data in BigQuery to find which behaviour predicts adoption, churn or contraction. Turn those signals into trigger rules: what counts, from which threshold, at what moment and for which customer group. You build the data models behind these signal

jobs.title: Acquisition Operations
jobs.description: Who We Are Zefir is building an AI autopilot for home sales in Europe, starting in France. Our agent runs each sale from listing to closing. It coordinates buyers, sellers, and local brokers, manages listings across property portals, and handles the paperwork. We help homeowners sell for the best price on a timeline that works for them. We’ve raised €60 million from Sequoia Capital and other leading investors. Our goal is to help millions of Europeans take the next step in their lives, whether that means moving to a new city for work or making room for a growing family. The mission Zefir sells homes with an AI agent, but our growth is still run mostly by hand. Every week, someone reads the dashboards, works out why bookings dropped on Tuesday, moves budget from one channel to another, asks for new creatives and fixes a broken tracking tag. Each of these tasks follows rules we could write down. Your job is to write them down and hand them to agents: software that watches the funnel all day, explains what changed and makes the routine fixes itself, within limits the team sets. You'll learn those rules by doing the work first. From day one you run our acquisition: around €1M of spend a month on Meta, Google and new channels, in a business growing about 2.5x a year. The number you answer for is the expected margin of each call we book. Cheap leads that never become sellers don't count. Anything you still do by hand after six months is a task you haven't automated yet. Few places let you try this. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile. We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue. We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance. This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading. The Role As Senior Product Manager, User Acquisition, you'll explore an important extension of how RevenueCat helps developers grow: helping them not just monetize the users they have, but acquire more of the right users in the first place. RevenueCat already has several footholds in user acquisition, including our Apple Ads integration and integrations across the attribution and MMP ecosystem. But we're still early in defining what a broader RevenueCat user acquisition product should become. You'll be the first dedicated product hire focused on this space, reporting directly to our product lead for Ads, with significant latitude to shape both the strategy and the products we build. This is a genuine zero-to-one role. You won't inherit a predetermined roadmap. Your job will be to deeply understand how app developers acquire users today, identify where RevenueCat has an opportunity to solve problems meaningfully better, and turn those insights into products we can test, ship, and scale. You'll bring real expertise in mobile performance

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager II - Vendor Spend
jobs.description: About Us: Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less. The Opportunity – Senior Product Manager II, Vendor Spend (Remote - USA / Canada) Do you love product problems where real money moves, mistakes have consequences, and a better workflow is worth millions in time and trust? Are you a self-starter who thrives on technical depth, systems thinking, and genuine customer stakes? Then this role is for you. We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own Vendor Spend: the vendor-payment layer of Wrapbook. This role owns how production companies pay their vendors — every payment method, the workflows around each payment, and the tracking and reporting that show customers exactly what's been paid. Your mandate is to broaden and speed up how vendors get paid, push toward straight-through processing, and open up net-new ways for productions to spend — while keeping every dollar accurate, compliant, and fraud-resistant. This is one of the higher-leverage roles in the product org. Vendor payments touch cash flow, fraud and AML exposure, tax reporting, and the general ledger, and they sit at the crossroads of banking, accounting, and go-to-market. You'll own a domain with high technical complexity, a large cross-team surface area, and a direct line to customer and business outcomes. You'll partner with a tenured engineering team, an experienced designer, and be a key product voice across the AP & Payments group and the teams upstream and downstream of you. jobs.title: Technical Project Manager
jobs.description: Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. The opportunity You work on our most strategic accounts and turn signed deals into live, revenue-generating deployments. On our largest global rollouts, successfully embedding BLP in the customer's system landscape (e.g., ERP) decides whether the go-live date holds. As a Technical Project Manager, you own the technical solution. You shape it with the customer's enterprise architects and IT leads, write the specification our engineers build from, and drive internal alignment and on-time delivery. What you'll do Shape the technical solution with the customer’s business and IT departments on large and complex accounts, and push until answers are specific enough to build on. Turn requirements into a clear, implementable specification for our engineers. Manage external and internal technical stakeholders, ensuring timely delivery and aligned priorities. Flag major development needs and blockers early, and bring a clear recommendation
